title: Cyrus and the Debt
author: Sebastian Okafor
blurb: Rosalind Whitlock, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
